caveat: Built from the 19 flights held locally, of which 17 produced footprints; 2 more could not be given a focal length and are UNKNOWN coverage, not zero. The parallel analysis lists 22 flights from 11-12.08 alone, of which 13 are NOT held here, including 20260812135747 which their table reports at 96 percent usable scale for every object size and which holds the fixed ropes. The searched fraction is therefore a LOWER BOUND and the never-imaged fraction an UPPER BOUND.
correction: An earlier merge of this same data used only 14 of the per-flight grids, because it ran before the last three finished, and reported 0.73 km2 and 8.1 percent. The correct figures over 17 grids are 0.906 km2 and 10.1 percent.
